documents_ruc_required.name: documents_ruc_required
documents_ruc_required.value: "documents"."doc_type" NOT IN ('01', '02') OR "documents"."counterparty_ruc" IS NOT NULL

license_orders_paid_fields.name: license_orders_paid_fields
license_orders_paid_fields.value: ("license_orders"."status" = 'paid') = ("license_orders"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL AND "license_orders"."provider_charge_id" IS NOT NULL AND "license_orders"."period_end" IS NOT NULL)

einvoice_settings_nubefact_credentials.name: einvoice_settings_nubefact_credentials
einvoice_settings_nubefact_credentials.value: "einvoice_settings"."provider" <> 'nubefact' OR ("einvoice_settings"."endpoint" IS NOT NULL AND "einvoice_settings"."token_encrypted" IS NOT NULL)

einvoices_customer.name: einvoices_customer
einvoices_customer.value: ("einvoices"."doc_type" <> '01' OR "einvoices"."customer_doc_type" = 'ruc') AND ("einvoices"."customer_doc_type" = 'none' OR ("einvoices"."customer_doc_number" IS NOT NULL AND "einvoices"."customer_name" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("einvoices"."doc_type" <> '03' OR "einvoices"."customer_doc_type" <> 'none' OR "einvoices"."total_cents" <= 70000)
